data.internal_split_rule: sort existing fit IDs by SHA256('diffrep5-inner:' + ID), first 20000 discovery; do not change any outer role
data.discovery_independence_guard: Do not reuse an analysis/gate checkpoint trained on the head-fit arrays. Prior adaptive research use is not erased by this internal split; no fresh-sample confirmation claim.

baseline_requirements.hierarchical_cost: sum all field calls at their actual tensor sizes; do not report steps as NFE

budget.shared_analysis_cost: count fully in each deployable pipeline even if physically trained once for attribution
budget.timing: synchronize; separate cold and warm; include all transforms, decoder, prior generation and transfers
budget.memory: peak allocated and reserved plus serialized model/cache bytes; remove unrelated resident models

proposed_development_go_rule.quality: against both competent full-image FM and strongest independently fitted latent control: KID gain >= max(0.001, 0.10 * control_raw_KID) on each seed and generation bank
proposed_development_go_rule.headroom: a nonpositive/noise-dominated control KID cannot support a relative-gain claim; mark that component inconclusive, not passed
proposed_development_go_rule.latency: candidate warm batch1 median <= 0.75 times the best-quality qualifying latent control at its declared solver setting
proposed_development_go_rule.throughput: candidate warm batch64 throughput not lower than that control
proposed_development_go_rule.training: all stages inside equal 7200-second pipeline budget; no cheap-head-only accounting
proposed_development_go_rule.memory: candidate peak at same batch <= 1.05 times latent control
proposed_development_go_rule.recall: feature recall drop no more than 0.02 absolute
proposed_development_go_rule.identity_control: must also compare to analysis-only; an unnecessary correction is not a win
proposed_development_go_rule.baseline_competence: active implementation or unresolved solver/training-budget failures make positive comparisons inconclusive
proposed_development_go_rule.copy: bitwise equal samples and density by identical computation; do not demand a strict win over the copy
proposed_development_go_rule.required_replication: screen plus both additional predeclared training seeds and independent-analysis control
